title: Automation the set can't hold is reported with its line
description:
As a producer, I want to be told when an automated move can't be kept, so that I know where the set differs.

```gherkin
Feature: Automation that can't be kept is reported
  Scenario: A parameter the DAW's device doesn't have
    Given the track "a" on line 9 automates a parameter that was left out of its device
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the export succeeds
    And the export warns: line 9, that automation was left out

  Scenario: Automating a volume beyond the fader's range
    Given the track "a" has "automate volume 1=0dB 5=+12dB"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the volume envelope reaches +12 dB through the track's Utility
    And the export does not warn
```

Note: which targets can't be kept follows the left-out list in `design/daw-set.md`; if every target maps, the first scenario checks the rule with the one left-out setting M3 found.
